content.title: A Homogeneous Benchmark of Exoplanet Mass-Radius Relations
content.abstract: The mass-radius ($M$-$R$) relation is fundamental to inferring the bulk composition and internal structure of exoplanets. However, published relations remain difficult to compare directly because studies adopt different planetary samples, fitting procedures, and evaluation metrics. We construct a homogeneous, quality-controlled benchmark of 963 exoplanets with dynamically measured masses and transit radii from the NASA Exoplanet Archive.
